entities.name: Retrobulbar block
observations: Intraconal injection can affect CN II, III, IV, and VI and sensory afferent fibers of V1.
The ophthalmic division of CN V is purely sensory and has no efferent motor fibers.

entities.name: Retrobulbar nerve pattern
observations: Retrobulbar anesthesia affects CN II, III, IV, VI and afferent V1 fibers; this corresponds to answer choice C.
